abstract: Dispatches coding work to resident ACP workers over a WebSocket through the acpw CLI. Workers with a stdio command — Claude, Codex, Cursor, and Grok — go through one pool daemon by default. Grok in the pool is grok agent stdio; acpw up grok still starts native serve. A public --session-id continues a pooled conversation across connections, child respawns, and daemon restarts when the agent advertises loadSession. The host agent keeps planning, scoping, and verification; workers only execute. Every command prints one JSON line, and an ok result means the ACP turn ended, not that the task is correct.
